values.subject: Dewu backend role written indication (pending interview and approval)
values.body_text: Hello Ji Chen. Based on your public resume and earlier call, we are providing non-binding role indications: compensation is calculated as monthly salary times 16 pay periods, with a base range above your current package. If interviews and approval are completed, the formal offer is expected to include a two-year non-compete covering peer e-commerce transaction roles. This is not a formal employment offer; details will be in the written offer after approval.
